description: Use for "which ads are getting tired?" or "should I refresh my creative?". Returns each ad's frequency, click rate and its change, and hook rate, highest frequency first, so you can see which ads people have seen too often. For the copy and video content itself use get_ad_copy_review; for account totals use get_performance. Saved data, refreshed by the hourly check.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.

name: get_ad_fatigue
